feature: Reduce excessive `any` type usage across codebase
workflow_rationale: This is a systematic refactor that replaces unsafe `any` types with proper TypeScript types. We'll use the refactor pattern: add proper types, migrate usages, verify no regressions. Each phase focuses on a specific category of `any` usage for systematic progress.

phases.name: Error Handling Types
phases.description: Replace `catch (err: any)` with `catch (error: unknown)` and add proper error narrowing. This is the most common pattern (~60 occurrences).

subtasks.description: Add error utility functions for type-safe error handling
subtasks.notes: Create utility functions: getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string, isErrorWithMessage(error: unknown): boolean

subtasks.description: Fix error handling in admin components (CategoryForm, CredentialFormDialog, etc.)

verification.expected: No type errors in modified files

subtasks.notes: Replace catch (err: any) with catch (error: unknown) and use getErrorMessage utility

subtasks.description: Fix error handling in lib/ utilities (db, api, email, locations)

verification.expected: No type errors in lib/ files

subtasks.notes: Added getErrorMessage() usage in email modules, fixed HeatLevel type casting

subtasks.description: Fix error handling in store components
subtasks.notes: Replaced catch (err: any) with catch (error: unknown) and used getErrorMessage() utility

phases.name: Zustand Store Types
phases.description: Replace (set: any, get: any) with proper StateCreator types from Zustand in all store files

subtasks.description: Fix Zustand types in cart store
subtasks.notes: Replace (set: any, get: any) with StateCreator<CartStore> from zustand. Import: import type { StateCreator } from 'zustand'

subtasks.description: Fix Zustand types in wishlist, comparison, and recently-viewed stores

verification.expected: No type errors in store files

subtasks.description: Fix Zustand types in mobile cart store

verification.expected: No type errors in mobile stores

phases.name: Prisma Query Types
phases.description: Replace dynamic `any` where clauses with proper Prisma.ModelWhereInput types

subtasks.description: Fix Prisma types in product queries
subtasks.notes: Added isValidHeatLevel() type guard to safely validate and narrow HeatLevel enum values. Replaced unsafe type assertions with proper type narrowing in getProducts() and getProductsCount() functions.

subtasks.description: Fix Prisma types in location queries
subtasks.notes: Imported Prisma type from @prisma/client, replaced 'any' types with Prisma.RetailLocationWhereInput, created LocationWithPhotos type using Prisma.RetailLocationGetPayload, typed transformLocation function properly, and fixed bug in photo sorting that was hidden by any types (was sorting URLs instead of photo objects)

subtasks.description: Fix Prisma types in admin pages (media, reviews)

verification.expected: No type errors in admin pages

subtasks.notes: Imported Prisma from '@prisma/client', replaced 'any' with Prisma.MediaWhereInput in media page and Prisma.ReviewWhereInput in reviews page

phases.name: API Response Types
phases.description: Define explicit types for API response objects instead of using `any` for details or error fields

subtasks.description: Add typed error details to lib/api.ts
subtasks.notes: Verified lib/api.ts - any types already replaced with unknown in subtask-1-3. fail() function uses details?: unknown, serverError() uses error?: unknown. This follows TypeScript best practices for safely handling untrusted input. Type-check passes with 0 errors.

subtasks.description: Fix API route response types

verification.expected: No type errors in API routes

subtasks.notes: Replaced all NextResponse.json() calls with standardized helper functions (ok, fail, serverError) from lib/api.ts. Changed catch (error: any) to catch (error: unknown) for type safety. Type-check passes with 0 errors.

phases.name: Function Parameter Types
phases.description: Replace function parameters typed as `any` with proper interfaces or generic types
